source_notes: Modelled 35 mm negative with a strong anti-halation layer. Radii follow the published physical range for backing reflection (first sigma ~65 um, wider bounces out to ~110 um) rather than the 0.55 mm the first version used, which P0 measured as a 0.66-0.72 mm half-energy radius.

Per-layer transfer: the local component returns red AND green so the inner ring reads warm; the global component returns almost only red so the outer reach reads red. Blue returns nothing through a strong anti-halation layer.

aura is all zeros here by construction: a modern stock with an intact anti-halation layer does not produce a large-radius return, and leaving the component present with zero transfer keeps the asset shape comparable to the no-remjet profile.
These are MODELLED values fitted to the described behaviour, not measured from a scan. A measured profile requires point-source and edge exposures on the same roll (plan 9.2).

Component transfers are tuned against the MEASURED print response, not against layer-space intuition: a pure red-layer bump already returns G/R ~ 0.30 in the print through the baked interlayer coupling, so the inner ring needs its own green return to read visibly warmer than the outer one.
